**Coverage gap analysis** identified 8 defensible gaps in the existing 77-test suite (GROUP 1–15). All gaps related to:
- Input isolation (upper bits of StoreData not harmlessly discarded)
- Alignment-corner documentation (SW/LW with non-zero AddrLSB)
- Boundary byte/halfword patterns at non-zero offsets
- Cross-path contamination with realistic input data
